newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in a dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in a dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed flat at 42.5460/5470 to the dollar in a dull session of interbank market, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted in a wide range at 42.5450/5480 per dollar in early trade.
"There were very few deals. Banks were more active in call market amid liquidity shortfall. Dollar demand will remain dull until year-end," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at 8.0 percent to 8.5 percent, dealers said.
